question_text: On 2025-12-08 (UTC), compare the crowd activity at DemoBooth_NVIDIA versus DemoBooth_Intel. Which booth was busier, and approximately what was the ratio of their average head_counts?
answer_text: DemoBooth_NVIDIA was busier. Its average head_count was 15.515 vs 10.648 at DemoBooth_Intel, for an approximate NVIDIA-to-Intel ratio of 1.46:1.

citations.cypher:
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
WHERE ch.camera_location IN ['DemoBooth_NVIDIA','DemoBooth_Intel']
  AND ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
WITH ch.camera_location AS booth,
     sum(toFloat(ch.avg_hc) * toFloat(ch.event_count)) AS wsum,
     sum(toFloat(ch.event_count)) AS total_samples
WITH booth,
     CASE WHEN total_samples > 0 THEN wsum / total_samples ELSE 0.0 END AS avg_hc,
     total_samples
WITH collect({booth: booth, avg_hc: avg_hc, total_samples: total_samples}) AS booths
WITH
  coalesce([b IN booths WHERE b.booth = 'DemoBooth_NVIDIA'][0].avg_hc, 0.0) AS nvidia_avg_hc,
  coalesce([b IN booths WHERE b.booth = 'DemoBooth_Intel'][0].avg_hc, 0.0) AS intel_avg_hc,
  coalesce([b IN booths WHERE b.booth = 'DemoBooth_NVIDIA'][0].total_samples, 0) AS nvidia_samples,
  coalesce([b IN booths WHERE b.booth = 'DemoBooth_Intel'][0].total_samples, 0) AS intel_samples
RETURN nvidia_avg_hc,
       intel_avg_hc,
       CASE WHEN intel_avg_hc = 0 THEN null ELSE nvidia_avg_hc / intel_avg_hc END AS avg_hc_ratio_nvidia_to_intel,
       CASE WHEN intel_avg_hc = 0 THEN null ELSE round((nvidia_avg_hc / intel_avg_hc) * 100.0) / 100.0 END AS avg_hc_ratio_approx_2dp,
       CASE WHEN nvidia_avg_hc > intel_avg_hc THEN 'DemoBooth_NVIDIA'
            WHEN intel_avg_hc > nvidia_avg_hc THEN 'DemoBooth_Intel'
            ELSE 'tie' END AS busier_booth,
       nvidia_samples,
       intel_samples
